whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: AFC-930 (parent AFC-923, follow-up to AFC-926 ruling A): Time Off leave register backing. Migration 20261030_0061 creates leave_requests (requester_user uuid NOT NULL + nullable requester_person; leave_type CHECK annual/sick/compassionate/study/unpaid/other; start/end DATE NOT NULL CHECK end>=start; reason TEXT NOT NULL non-blank; status pending/approved/rejected DEFAULT pending; decided_by/at stamped together, NULL while pending; branch uuid NOT NULL + zone denorm Flow-maintained) with bootstrap-role guard per 0001/0042, conditional FKs under FIXED names (people/branches RESTRICT, zones SET NULL; Directus-owned user ids bare uuid no FK, 0037 precedent), zone backfill from branch, and no roles provisioned (ADR-0002). Grants: SELECT plus column-scoped INSERT/UPDATE to directus_app; NO DELETE on either table; PUBLIC revoked. leave_request_events is the explicit audit (created/updated/status_changed/note, transfer_events precedent). The down script refuses with restrict_violation while either table holds rows, then drops child-first with no CASCADE. Reconciles (never forks) staging's unowned leave_requests table via IF NOT EXISTS + conditional constraints (AFC-925); does NOT create leave_balances and seeds no Directus policy rows (both owned by other slices). F1 fix (AFC-934 blocking): all enum/non-blank CHECKs now carry FIXED names and §2b refuses to adopt a divergent staging table instead of silently no-op'ing. F2 fix (AFC-934 non-blocking, due with routes): zone_admin added to reason FIELD_RESTRICTIONS roles (MATRIX already grants zone_admin CRU as deciding officer).
